Exercise: One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- hinge
- pull

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- forearms
- glutes
- lower back
- quadriceps
- shoulders

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system, glycolytic system

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improving_grip_strength_and_stability
- developing_strength_in_the_hamstrings,_glutes,_and_shoulders

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain or injury

Exercise Variations:

- name: Two-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean, force: pull, level: advanced
- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean with Overhead Press, force: push and pull, level: intermediate

Substitution Options:

- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean, force: pull, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Place one kettlebell between your feet.
- Grab the handle with one hand and raise the kettlebell rapidly, let it flip so that the ball of the kettlebell lands in the palm of your hand.
- Throw the kettlebell out in front of you and catch the handle with one hand.
- Take the kettlebell to the floor and repeat. Make sure to work both arms.
